channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about David Blitzer | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about David Blitzer from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Josh Harris, David Blitzer
item.description:
“I’m honored to be named head coach of the Philadelphia 76ers, a storied franchise in a tradition-rich city. Thank you to Josh Harris, David Blitzer and the ownership group for this incredible opportunity,”

Nick Nurse on Josh Harris, David Blitzer, Jun 1, 2023. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Adam Silver on Josh Harris, David Blitzer
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Adam Silver:

“I'm really pleased with what they're doing [in Philly]. Josh Harris, David Blitzer. It's everything you could ask for from a league office standpoint.”

Adam Silver on Josh Harris, David Blitzer, Nov 29, 2017. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Josh Harris, David Blitzer
item.description:
In fact, owernship’s initial reluctance to give Colangelo final say led to him turning down their first offer.

“The first time that I met with David Blitzer and Josh Harris I basically told them I’m not the guy for this job,”

Bryan Colangelo on Josh Harris, David Blitzer, Sep 22, 2016. Source: Philadelphia Magazine.
